## skenv link

Create store and agent links without pulling

### Synopsis

Create store links for own skills and agent links for every skill.

```
skenv link [flags]
```

### Options

```
      --adopt             move conflicting unmanaged paths to ~/.local/state/skenv/backup/<ts>/ and replace them
      --dry-run           print the plan, change nothing
  -h, --help              help for link
      --manifest string   path to env.toml
```
